Two students decided to carry out an investigation around their school to test the following
hypotheses:
Hypothesis 1: Temperatures are higher nearer to buildings and decrease away from
buildings.
Hypothesis 2: The wind speed decreases as the distance from the buildings increases.
To test Hypothesis 1 the students used a digital thermometer. This instrument is shown
in Fig. 2.3 (Insert). They selected seven sites around the school campus and recorded the
temperature at each site. The sites are shown on Fig. 2.2 and Fig. 2.4 (Insert).
